name: Simulator dispatch intake
purpose: A dispatch decision offered to the Simulator for execution. The answer is the simulator.dispatch-outcome.v1 contract.
authority_level: Simulator validation and physical execution intake; a decision is a proposal and carries no Core, scheduling or approval authority
security_classification: Internal simulation dispatch metadata; SIMULATION provenance; no credentials and no evaluator-only (Oracle) field

semantics.revalidation: A decision is rechecked against current simulated state when it arrives and again when its kernel event executes (SCH-INV-02); held material is never dispatched (SCH-INV-05).
semantics.idempotency: dispatch_id is the idempotency key: identical bytes return the stored answer and run nothing, different bytes under the same id are rejected as DUPLICATE_CONFLICT.
semantics.ordering: Execution is a kernel event ordered by (time, sequence); decision_time must equal the current simulation time.
semantics.core: source CORE_AUTHORIZED requires a prior Core LotDispatchAuthorized fact (core.lot-dispatch-authorized.v1) for the same dispatch_id, lot_id and lot_revision; the Simulator holds no Core client and mutates no Core state.
semantics.completeness: Offline interface slice: not integrated acceptance, not a Scheduler IC-SCH-005 schema (that stays a Scheduler deliverable) and not event-spine publication.
